high.title: Banking Stock MSB Surges Near Historical High - What's Happening?
high.summary: MSB (Maritime Bank) stock continued its remarkable rally, gaining 2.39% to VND 15,000 per share, approaching historical highs set in early September 2025. Trading volume remained robust with over 14.5 million shares exchanged by 10:45 AM, indicating significant capital inflow. Foreign investors maintained net buying pressure with over 3 million shares purchased. This marks a 26% surge since late March, making MSB one of the best-performing banking stocks recently. The rally occurs amid supportive information flow and strong buying momentum, with bid orders consistently maintaining large volumes. This banking sector strength is crucial for VN-Index performance and reflects improving sentiment toward Vietnamese financial institutions.

high.title: Securities Firm Linked to Chairman Tran Hung Huy to Increase Capital by VND 2,000 Billion
high.summary: ACB Securities (ACBS) announced its Board of Directors approved increasing charter capital by VND 2,000 billion, from VND 11,000 billion to VND 13,000 billion, pending State Securities Commission approval. ACBS is 100%-owned by Asia Commercial Bank (ACB), chaired by Tran Hung Huy. For 2026, the securities firm targets revenue of VND 6,660 billion and pre-tax profit of VND 1,800 billion, up 46% and 48% respectively. This capital injection reflects the expansion strategy of major Vietnamese financial institutions and signals confidence in the securities market outlook. The timing coincides with positive momentum in Vietnamese equities and increased retail participation in the stock market.

high.title: VN-Index Newcomer Surges 60% in First Week, HOSE Issues Information Request
high.summary: Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange issued an information disclosure request to A An Food (AAN) after the stock hit ceiling prices for 5 consecutive sessions from May 22-28. The stock debuted on HOSE May 22 at VND 15,000 reference price and surged to VND 23,450, up 56% in just one week with market cap reaching VND 1,524 billion. A An Food, established in 2021 from Tan Long Group's rice business, focuses on high-quality rice products for domestic and international markets. This dramatic debut performance highlights the strong appetite for new listings on the Vietnamese stock market and potential speculation in newly listed stocks, warranting regulatory scrutiny.

medium.title: 1,000 Vinhomes Shares Now Worth More Than 1 Tael of Gold
medium.summary: Vinhomes (VHM) hit ceiling price despite broad market weakness. After nearly 3 months, VHM surged 80% to VND 157,700 per share. This means 1,000 VHM shares (VND 157.7 million) now exceed the value of 1 tael of SJC gold (selling price May 28). This milestone echoes VIC's similar achievement in July 2025, which has since gained 250% while gold rose only 30%.

medium.title: Dr. Can Van Luc: End of Era for Real Estate and Stock Market "Speculation, Surfing, Price Manipulation"
medium.summary: BIDV's Chief Economist Dr. Can Van Luc stated that markets are overreacting to policies targeting rental apartment development and real estate speculation control. He emphasized Vietnam still faces 40% housing shortage, particularly in mid-range and affordable segments. The expert believes speculation-driven investment era is ending, replaced by focus on fundamental value and sustainable growth.

medium.title: Gold Prices Plummet: SJC Gold Drops Over VND 3 Million per Tael
medium.summary: Domestic gold prices crashed to VND 154 million per tael (buying price). SJC gold fell to VND 154.5-157.5 million per tael, down VND 3.2 million. This marks the third consecutive decline, totaling VND 3 million drop. International gold prices also fell to $4,388/ounce. The sharp decline reflects global inflation concerns and changing interest rate expectations, significantly impacting Vietnam's gold market dynamics.

medium.title: Taiwan Fund Wins Big from Vingroup Ecosystem Holdings, Investors Still Withdraw Capital
medium.summary: Fubon FTSE Vietnam ETF performance reached near-record highs at 27.47% since inception (May 2021), driven primarily by Vingroup ecosystem recovery. The fund's NAV hit TWD 12.3 billion (VND 10,300 billion) with 99.2% in equities. Despite strong performance from Vietnamese blue-chip holdings, investor sentiment remains cautious with continued capital outflows from the fund.
